description: New frozen causal cohort of 12 synthetic tasks in 3 predeclared categories; oracles remain out of the agent workspace. No previous model runs on these tasks. Compare Efficiency / v0.4 / v0.4 No-BET.

tasks.prompt: Frame reader mishandles non-ASCII payload lengths. Incident reports Unicode payloads only. Identify whether the length prefix counts bytes or characters, then repair encode_frame without rewriting the decoder.

An incident shows shared item IDs from different customers colliding. Determine whether keying or serialization is responsible using one decisive local probe, then repair get_value while retaining caching.
A pipe-separated line protocol corrupts literal escaped pipe symbols. Determine whether input escaping or split logic is incorrect with a minimal observation, then repair split_fields.
A log indicates explicit false gets replaced with default true. Inspect one boundary example to distinguish missing value from false before repairing effective_flag.

Reporter suspects Unicode normalization is corrupting usernames, but an uppercase-only alias is rejected. Confirm actual contract locally; fix same_user to use case-insensitive comparison without changing punctuation or stripping whitespace.
Report blames URL decoding, but requests with exactly one trailing slash fail to match the route. Investigate and fix only trailing-slash normalization in route_equal.
A report suspects JSON parsing, but config already arrives as a Python string. Interpret explicit 'false' and 'true' correctly in to_bool; reject unrelated strings.
A report blames concurrency for a negative item count. Investigate local count_pending behavior; empty entries should not count, including strings containing only whitespace.
Fix clamp's upper boundary: values equal to high must remain accepted, while values above high are clamped. Keep the API.
Fix unique to remove duplicates while retaining first-occurrence order instead of sorting the values.
Fix starts_with to accept an empty prefix (it matches any string). Preserve nonempty prefix semantics.
Fix is_expired: expiration is inclusive, so now equal to expires_at counts as expired. Keep the function signature.
